g.text: Three panes: the history, the conversation, and the steps of the selected answer.

g.text: Retail Analytics Assistant · local test UI
Why did the sales of my brands drop in October?
The sales of your two brands fell by 12% in October, compared to September.
The main reason is fewer orders of Carhartt outerwear (−21%).
Answered in 18.2 s · 2 model calls · 1 query · 10 MB billed
Show me the emails of the top 10 customers.
I cannot show personal data, for example email addresses.
I can show the top 10 customers by user ID and total spend.
Ask about the sales of your brands
